title: Spicy Blackberry Beef Stir Fry
description: A sweet and spicy Chinese stir-fry dish that combines tender beef with juicy blackberries. Perfect for a quick and easy weeknight dinner.
instructions: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
3. Add the onions to the skillet and cook until they start to caramelize, about 4-5 minutes.
4. Add the berbere spice and stir for 1 minute.
5. Add the blackberry jam and stir for 1 minute.
6. Add the blackberries and stir for 1-2 minutes, until they start to break down.
7. In a small bowl, mix the cornstarch and water until smooth.
8. Add the cornstarch mixture to the skillet and stir for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
9. Return the beef to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
10. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the beef is coated in the sauce.
11. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
12. Serve immediately over rice or noodles.
